Person appears to be forcibly entering or manipulating the cash register/POS system—leaning over it with hands deeply inserted into the machine or drawer, possibly prying it open or extracting contents without authorization. No visible staff presence or customer interaction; behavior is consistent with burglary (theft from point-of-sale terminal).
